t: A tiny eight-legged chip for small permanent light and sensor gadgets.
steps: Buy bare ATtiny85 chips from SparkFun or DigiKey for about 1.50 to 3.50 US dollars each.
Get a breadboard, some jumper wires, and an Arduino Uno to act as the programmer.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the ATTinyCore board package.
Upload the ArduinoISP example to the Uno and wire it to the ATtiny85.
Pick the ATtiny85 board and choose 8 MHz internal.
Click Burn Bootloader once to set the clock speed correctly.
Upload the Blink example and watch an LED flash on pin 0.
meta: Wild Open. From $1.66. Easy to find.
